MARANATHA P.160• The events connected with the close of probationand the work of preparation for the time of trouble,are clearly presented. But multitudes have no moreunderstanding of these important truths than if theyhad never been revealed. Satan watches to catch awayevery impression that would make them wise untosalvation, and the time of trouble will find themunready.
